quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Chemical Industrial semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half to September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 20,998 million (up JPY 320 million YoY), operating profit JPY 1,390 million (down JPY 1,010 million), ordinary profit JPY 1,374 million (down JPY 1,019 million), interim profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 1,336 million (down JPY 297 million). Management states sales rose as electronic ceramic materials for automotive and communications increased, while operating profit fell on a time lag in passing battery-material raw-material price swings into selling prices and the loss of the prior year's inventory-writedown reduction effect. Chemicals sales JPY 9,079 million (down JPY 7 million); Functional Products sales JPY 11,307 million (up JPY 563 million) - electronic ceramic materials sales rose sharply as automotive stayed strong and communications grew sharply, high-purity electronic materials rose sharply on recovering semiconductor demand, battery materials fell sharply on lower resource prices and circuit materials fell sharply. R&D expense JPY 745 million.
